exoticPerks.name: Burning Souls
exoticPerks.shortDescription: [Solar]Solar final blows grant Burning Souls. Dodge applies Cure.
exoticPerks.description: Activating your class ability grants Cure. Rapid [Solar]Solar final blows grant stacks of Burning Souls that increase Solar ability damage, increase the potency of Dodge's healing, and spreads the healing to nearby allies.

descriptions.flavorText: The frigid will renewed, resurgent.

exoticPerks.name: Depths of Duskfield
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Duskfield grenades have a larger effect and reduce the damage that allies take.
exoticPerks.description: Your Duskfield grenades have a much larger effect radius. Allies inside the Duskfield gain Frost Armor and targets inside the area deal reduced damage.

descriptions.flavorText: "We are unique emanations of the same shared Light." —Cult of the Aeons
"My only wish is for this disrespect to end." — Ol-Amral

exoticPerks.name: Wish-Dragon's Talons
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Banner of War grants melee energy.
exoticPerks.description: Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Frenzied Blade and Flechette Storm briefly increase their damage with each strike. Pulses from your Banner of War return melee energy based on the number of allies healed.

descriptions.flavorText: "Have I the aspic in my lips?"

exoticPerks.shortDescription: Improved weapon ready speed, reload, and melee range.

descriptions.flavorText: They do not yet know what true cold is.

descriptions.flavorText: The frigid will renewed, resurgent.

exoticPerks.name: Depths of Duskfield
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Duskfield grenades have a larger effect and reduce the damage that allies take.
exoticPerks.description: Your Duskfield grenades have a much larger effect radius. Allies inside the Duskfield gain Frost Armor and targets inside the area deal reduced damage.

descriptions.flavorText: "We are unique emanations of the same shared Light." —Cult of the Aeons
"My only wish is for this disrespect to end." — Ol-Amral

exoticPerks.name: Wish-Dragon's Talons
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Banner of War grants melee energy.
exoticPerks.description: Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Frenzied Blade and Flechette Storm briefly increase their damage with each strike. Pulses from your Banner of War return melee energy based on the number of allies healed.

descriptions.flavorText: "Have I the aspic in my lips?"

exoticPerks.name: Cobra Totemic
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Improved weapon ready speed, reload, and melee range.
exoticPerks.description: Improves melee range as well as ready speed and reload for weapons. Provides a small benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.

descriptions.flavorText: They do not yet know what true cold is.

exoticPerks.name: Hearts of Ice
exoticPerks.shortDescription: Winter's Wrath gives targets increased Shatter damage and buffs allies.
exoticPerks.description: Targets frozen by your Winter's Wrath Super take increased Shatter damage. Allies in range of your Winter's Wrath shockwave and Frostpulse gain Frost Armor and deal increased damage with Stasis weapons. Granting these buffs to allies grants you Super energy.

descriptions.flavorText: We strive to know infinity, and sharpen our minds on the whetstone of the impossible.
